# hash fields: px_py_pz_vx_vy_vz as lowercase hex of f32::to_bits()
# Regia's own vector: the loop and the hash format are those of DO27's vector of the same name, the hull is the engine's
# (no baseline-game numbers, ADR-8012 A-8). The hull covers 464.45 m in the 1000 ticks, reaches its 30 m/s cap, and rests
# 0.5 micrometres under its 1 m ride height. Recorded on x86_64-linux; a change that moves this line is a sim-version
# change (ADR-8019). DO27 pins the same vector on its own hull in its own repository.
